digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent runaway guard
propositions: Completion-verification close gate aborts with RunawayToolLoopError when verifier re-reads memoized evidence files, despite prior runaway-guard and memo fixes, because the guard layer sits outermost and counts memo-served (cached, free) repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer answers.

Distinct-ratio runaway guard and memoization path-normalized cache conflict: lever 2 (memo) made repeats cheap, but guard still penalizes them via the outermost layer order, causing the two fixes to fight each other.

Guard must track and count only EXECUTED tool calls (cache misses) in the distinct-ratio window, not OBSERVED calls; memo-served cache hits should never increment loop evidence and should extend a served-streak that is independently bounded.
Pure cache-served loops (zero execution over a full window of calls) must still be detected and bounded by a served-streak backstop arm, preventing infinite recycling of cached responses.

Five execution record sites in the memo layer must call record_executed: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, read_file with unparseable path, read_file first-read whole-file fetch, and read_file past-window fallback read.
